   167→    def _generate_shared_module(self, data_model, patterns: List[str]) -> FVLangModule:
   168→        """공유 모듈 생성 (엔티티 정의 + Factory)"""
   169→        module = FVLangModule(name="shared")
   170→
   171→        # [1] struct 생성
   172→        for entity in data_model.entities:
   173→            struct_code = self._entity_to_struct(entity)
   174→            module.structs.append(struct_code)
   175→
   176→        # [2] Factory 함수 (패턴 적용 시)
   177→        if "Factory" in patterns:
   178→            for entity in data_model.entities:
   179→                factory_fn = self._generate_factory_function(entity)
   180→                module.functions.append(factory_fn)
   181→
   182→        # [3] Builder 함수 (패턴 적용 시)
   183→        if "Builder" in patterns:
   184→            for entity in data_model.entities:
   185→                if len(entity.fields) >= 5:
   186→                    builder_fn = self._generate_builder_function(entity)
   187→                    module.functions.append(builder_fn)
   188→
   189→        # [4] Singleton 캐시 (패턴 적용 시)
   190→        if "Singleton" in patterns:
   191→            singleton_fn = self._generate_singleton_cache()
   192→            module.functions.append(singleton_fn)
   193→
   194→        return module
   195→
   196→    def _entity_to_struct(self, entity: DataEntity) -> str:
   197→        """엔티티 → struct 정의"""
   198→        lines = [f"struct {entity.name} {{"]
   199→
   200→        for field in entity.fields:
   201→            # DataField로 변환 (간단히)
   202→            fv_type = self.type_mapper.map_base_type(field.type)
   203→
   204→            if field.nullable:
   205→                fv_type = f"Option<{fv_type}>"
   206→
   207→            hints = []
   208→            if field.indexed:
   209→                hints.append("indexed")
   210→            if field.unique:
   211→                hints.append("unique")
   212→
   213→            hint_str = f"  // {', '.join(hints)}" if hints else ""
   214→            lines.append(f"    {field.name}: {fv_type},{hint_str}")
   215→
   216→        lines.append("}")
   217→        return "\n".join(lines)
   218→
   219→    def _generate_factory_function(self, entity: DataEntity) -> str:
   220→        """Factory 함수 생성"""
   221→        entity_lower = entity.name.lower()
   222→        lines = [
   223→            f"fn create_{entity_lower}(",
   224→            "    // 필드 인자들",
   225→            f") -> {entity.name} {{",
   226→            f"    return {entity.name} {{",
   227→        ]
   228→
   229→        for field in entity.fields:
   230→            lines.append(f"        {field.name}: {field.name},")
   231→
   232→        lines.append("    };")
   233→        lines.append("}")
   234→
   235→        return "\n".join(lines)
   236→
   237→    def _generate_builder_function(self, entity: DataEntity) -> str:
   238→        """Builder 함수 생성"""
   239→        entity_lower = entity.name.lower()
   240→        lines = [
   241→            f"struct {entity.name}Builder {{",
   242→        ]
   243→
   244→        for field in entity.fields:
   245→            fv_type = self.type_mapper.map_base_type(field.type)
   246→            if field.nullable:
   247→                fv_type = f"Option<{fv_type}>"
   248→            lines.append(f"    {field.name}: {fv_type},")
   249→
   250→        lines.append("}")
   251→        lines.append("")
   252→        lines.append(f"impl {entity.name}Builder {{")
   253→        lines.append(f"    fn build(self) -> Result<{entity.name}, Error> {{")
   254→        lines.append(f"        return Ok({entity.name} {{")
   255→        for field in entity.fields:
   256→            lines.append(f"            {field.name}: self.{field.name},")
   257→        lines.append("        });")
   258→        lines.append("    }")
   259→        lines.append("}")
   260→
   261→        return "\n".join(lines)

   263→    def _generate_singleton_cache(self) -> str:
   264→        """Singleton 캐시 함수"""
   265→        lines = [
   266→            "fn get_cache_instance() -> Rc<RefCell<HashMap<string, string>>> {",
   267→            "    // 캐시 초기화 (한 번만 실행)",
   268→            "    static CACHE: Rc<RefCell<HashMap<string, string>>> = Rc::new(RefCell::new(HashMap::new()));",
   269→            "    return CACHE;",
   270→            "}",
   271→        ]
   272→        return "\n".join(lines)

   274→    def _generate_service_module(
   275→        self,
   276→        service: MicroService,
   277→        architecture: SystemArchitecture,
   278→        patterns: List[str]
   279→    ) -> FVLangModule:
   280→        """서비스 모듈 생성"""
   281→        module = FVLangModule(name=service.name)
   282→
   283→        # [1] API 엔드포인트 함수
   284→        for endpoint in service.api_endpoints:
   285→            fn_code = self._endpoint_to_function(endpoint)
   286→            module.functions.append(fn_code)
   287→
   288→        # [2] Repository 함수 (DB 사용 서비스)
   289→        if "Repository" in patterns and service.database and service.database != "none":
   290→            for entity in architecture.data_model.entities:
   291→                repo_funcs = self._generate_repository_functions(entity)
   292→                module.functions.extend(repo_funcs)
   293→
   294→        # [3] 캐싱 함수
   295→        for entity in architecture.data_model.entities:
   296→            if entity.cache_strategy and entity.cache_strategy != "none":
   297→                cache_funcs = self._generate_cache_functions(entity)
   298→                module.functions.extend(cache_funcs)
   299→
   300→        # [4] 이벤트 함수 (queue 사용 서비스)
   301→        if service.queue and service.queue != "none":
   302→            event_funcs = self._generate_event_functions(service)
   303→            module.functions.extend(event_funcs)
   304→
   305→        return module

   307→    def _endpoint_to_function(self, endpoint: ServiceEndpoint) -> str:
   308→        """엔드포인트 → 함수"""
   309→        method = endpoint.method.lower()
   310→        path = endpoint.path.strip('/').replace('/', '_')
   311→        fn_name = f"{method}_{path}"
   312→
   313→        # 파라미터
   314→        params = []
   315→        if endpoint.request_schema:
   316→            for key, field_type in endpoint.request_schema.items():
   317→                fv_type = self.type_mapper.map_base_type(field_type)
   318→                params.append(f"{key}: {fv_type}")
   319→
   320→        params_str = ", ".join(params) if params else ""
   321→
   322→        # 반환값
   323→        if endpoint.response_schema:
   324→            response_type = self.type_mapper.format_response_schema_to_type(endpoint.response_schema)
   325→        else:
   326→            response_type = "string"
   327→
   328→        lines = [
   329→            f"fn {fn_name}({params_str}) -> Result<{response_type}, Error> {{",
   330→            "    // ratelimit: 100/min",
   331→            "    return Err(\"not_implemented\".to_string());",
   332→            "}",
   333→        ]
   334→
   335→        return "\n".join(lines)

   337→    def _generate_repository_functions(self, entity: DataEntity) -> List[str]:
   338→        """Repository 함수 생성 (find_by_id, save, delete)"""
   339→        entity_lower = entity.name.lower()
   340→        funcs = []
   341→
   342→        # find_by_id
   343→        funcs.append(f"""fn find_{entity_lower}_by_id(id: string) -> Result<{entity.name}, Error> {{
   344→    // DB 조회 로직
   345→    return Err("not_found".to_string());
   346→}}""")
   347→
   348→        # save
   349→        funcs.append(f"""fn save_{entity_lower}(item: {entity.name}) -> Result<string, Error> {{
   350→    // DB 저장 로직
   351→    return Ok(item.id);
   352→}}""")
   353→
   354→        # delete
   355→        funcs.append(f"""fn delete_{entity_lower}(id: string) -> Result<bool, Error> {{
   356→    // DB 삭제 로직
   357→    return Ok(true);
   358→}}""")
   359→
   360→        return funcs
   361→
   362→    def _generate_cache_functions(self, entity: DataEntity) -> List[str]:

   364→        entity_lower = entity.name.lower()

   372→
   373→        # set_cached

   375→    // Redis 캐시 저장 (TTL: 1h)

   377→}}""")
   378→
   379→        return funcs

   381→    def _generate_event_functions(self, service: MicroService) -> List[str]:
   382→        """이벤트 함수 생성 (publish, consume)"""
   383→        funcs = []
   384→
   385→        # publish_event
   386→        funcs.append(f"""fn publish_event(event_type: string, payload: string) -> Result<bool, Error> {{
   387→    // 이벤트 발행 ({service.queue})

   389→}}""")
   390→
   391→        # consume_events
   392→        funcs.append(f"""fn consume_events(handler: fn(string) -> Result<(), Error>) -> Result<(), Error> {{
   393→    // 이벤트 소비

   396→

   399→    def _add_security_checks(self, module: FVLangModule, security_controls: Dict) -> None:
   400→        """보안 검사 함수 추가"""
   401→        # JWT 인증

   411→            rbac_fn = """fn check_permission(claims: Claims, required_role: string) -> Result<bool, Error> {

   414→}"""

   416→
   417→        # 입력 검증
   418→        validation_fn = """fn validate_input(input: string) -> Result<string, ValidationError> {
   419→    // 입력 검증

### Stage 4 구현 시 핵심 주의사항

1. **기존 `HealingSurgeon`은 단일 코드 문자열 기반**: `__init__(self, code: str, ...)` 이므로, Stage 4에서는 `GeneratedCode.modules`를 전체 합쳐서 단일 코드로 변환하거나, 모듈별로 개별 처리하는 방식을 선택해야 합니다. `module.to_code()` 로 각 모듈을 문자열로 변환 후 `"\n\n".join(...)` 가 가장 자연스럽습니다.

2. **test_cases는 Dict 리스트**: `TestRunner.run_tests()`가 `List[Dict[str, Any]]`를 받으므로, `generated.test_cases`를 그대로 전달 가능합니다.
